messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: P-5421 fired in #incidents — inference-eu-embedder 5xx spike :rotating_light: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P-5421

carla (support): customers reporting 502s, tickets piling. acct-237 and acct-981 called in.

anna (oncall): acked. I'm joining the bridge and triaging now.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: anna (oncall) acknowledged P-5421

luis (SRE): looking at eu-west1 pools + logs. seeing KV cache eviction bursts and batch queue backpressure.

ben (infra): i see autoscaler didn't kick for the high seq length bursts, might be a threshold bug.

anna (oncall): customer impact? rough numbers?

carla (support): ~5% of requests returning 502s across 3 customers, some timeouts in support console. CS notified.

luis (SRE): starting mitigation: scaling dedicated pool +2 nodes and enabling fallback routing to model-v1-q4 (quantized).

ben (infra): rolling restart suspect replicaset: `kubectl rollout restart rs/embedder-eu-embedder -n inference` — doing one zone at a time.

anna (oncall): assigning ownership for remediation and comms?

luis (SRE): i'll own remediation. @ben please handle autoscaler fix and rollback if needed. anna, can you handle customer comms?

pagerbot: PagerDuty: ownership assigned to luis (SRE)

ben (infra): pushed autoscaler hotfix (staging -> prod). monitoring rollout, should be live in ~90s.

luis (SRE): activated fallback routing 30% to model-v1-q4. error rate dropped ~70%, latency up ~40ms. keeping fallback while autoscaler stabilizes.

carla (support): confirmed with customers: degraded but usable under fallback. CSMs updated and tickets annotated.

anna (oncall): good. ETA to full recovery?

luis (SRE): estimate 25-35m for full recovery depending on autoscaler settle. I'll post updates every 10m.

ben (infra): relevant quick commands used: 
```
kubectl logs -n inference -l app=embedder -c embedder --tail 200
kubectl rollout restart rs/embedder-eu-embedder -n inference
```

luis (SRE): logs snippet: `2026-03-17T12:05:21Z embedder: async batch overflow: kvcache_miss=0.42 backpressure=1.0` — autoscaler threshold prevented spin-up.

anna (oncall): noted. i'll draft PSAs and sync with cs for any SLA exposure.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: P-5421 acknowledged by luis (SRE) — status: investigating

carla (support): customers prefer status updates every 30min, leaving ticket watch on.

luis (SRE): scaling stabilized, error rate trending down. keeping fallback at 30% for 10m then ramping traffic back. next update in 10.

anna (oncall): thanks team. i'll keep executive ping list updated. please add any persistent remediation notes to the incident.
